entries.title: Describe a color theme of your own
entries.body: Tell your first mate the colors you want, such as “an old green terminal”, and it saves a theme of your own and puts it on at once. Ask again under the same name to change it. Infinitary keeps every color easy to read, says which colors it adjusted, and sends a theme back when a color would be hard to tell from another, such as working from calm. Your themes are listed under Yours in Settings → Appearance → Theme, where Remove takes the one you have on away.
